description: This file defines the SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams class, which extends a base FilterParams class and adds specific fields for review ID and self-evaluation status, potentially used for filtering supervisor evaluation search results within a performance management module.

classes.name: SupervisorEvaluationSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that represents the filter parameters for supervisor evaluation search queries in the performance module.

methods.name: getReviewId
methods.description: Retrieves the review ID used as a filter for supervisor evaluation search.
